EMAIL = re.compile(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+\.[\w.]+")
PHONE = re.compile(r"\+?\d[\d ()-]{7,}\d")
CARD = re.compile(r"\b(?:\d[ -]?){13,19}\b")

def scrub(text):
    return EMAIL.sub("[EMAIL]", CARD.sub("[CARD]", PHONE.sub("[PHONE]", text)))
